analysis:
The problem states that the king gives a gold coin to exactly one of his 100 subjects each year, and no subject can receive more than one coin in their lifetime. The question asks for the number of years after which the king can stop giving out coins and the maximum number of coins any subject can receive.

First, we need to determine the maximum number of coins any subject can receive. Since no subject can receive more than one coin in their lifetime, the maximum number of coins any subject can receive is 1.

Next, we need to determine after how many years the king can stop giving out coins. Since there are 100 subjects and the king gives a coin to exactly one subject each year, the king can continue giving out coins for 100 years. After 100 years, all subjects will have received one coin, and the king will have given out all 100 coins.

Therefore, the king can stop giving out coins after 100 years, and the maximum number of coins any subject can receive is 1.
